author: Midnightstorm
body:
Triikky

Combat logging

Around three weeks ago I had received two infractions for the same exact incident; combat logging. On the Avicus punishment guidelines page, the first offense of combat logging is an hour long ban. The second offense is a day long ban. I got banned the first time for a minute (October 1, 2015 at 9:14pm - October 1, 2015 at 9:13 PM). The next day when I logged on, the moderator told me I should be temp banned and banned me again for one day (October 2, 2015 at 5:54pm - October 3, 2015 at 5:52 PM). I find this unfair because I only combat logged once, but received two infractions for it.

Thank you for taking the time to read my appeal, have a great night.
~Midnight
